_meta.title: England & Wales: prison population by ethnicity, by prison, quarterly Sept 2015 - June 2026
_meta.measures: Number of people held in each prison (and immigration removal centre run by the prison service) on the last day of each quarter, by recorded ethnic group and sex. Compare a prison's share of Black or Asian prisoners with their share of the population of England and Wales.
_meta.source: Ministry of Justice, Offender Management Statistics Quarterly, Prison Population data tool: 30 June 2026 (view 'd Establishment*Sex*Ethnicity')
_meta.licence_quote: All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated
_meta.citation: Ministry of Justice (2026). Offender Management Statistics Quarterly: January to March 2026, Prison Population data tool 30 June 2026. Crown copyright, OGL v3.0.
_meta.coordinates: Wikidata P625 (CC0 1.0, https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Wikidata:Licensing), matched by prison name via SPARQL; QID on each record
_meta.keys: <group> = all sexes; <group>_male / <group>_female by sex; total = all groups. Dates are YYYY-MM (quarter end).

england_wales_population_2021_census.source: 2021 Census populations as used in the Home Office stop and search ethnic disparity workbook (OGL v3)

notes: Units listed separately by MoJ (Feltham A/B, Parc A/B, Peterborough male/female, IRC wings) share their site's coordinates.
Closed prisons (e.g. Holloway, Glen Parva) are kept with the dates they appear in the source.
